entities.name: Sorin's Betrayal
entities.description: A pivotal event on Innistrad in 3560 AR in which Sorin created Avacyn and the Helvault and imprisoned Nahiri.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who acted to protect humanity.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A kor lithomancer and planeswalker, Sorin's old ally, imprisoned in the Helvault.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An archangel created by Sorin as guardian of humanity.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A prison forged by Sorin from a piece of Innistrad's silver moon.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's grandfather, who dismissed his concerns.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Sorin's betrayal occurred.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's world, where vampires destabilized the Eldrazi's prison.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A being Nahiri called on for aid and Sorin told her to seek.

entities.name: Sundering of the Helvault
entities.description: The event that freed Nahiri after nearly a millennium.

events.summary: Sorin, finding vampires pushing humanity toward extinction, acts unilaterally after Edgar Markov dismisses his concerns.
events.quote: When his grandfather Edgar Markov dismissed his concerns, Sorin acted unilaterally.

events.summary: Sorin creates Avacyn as a guardian of humanity; angels strike down vampires and other threats.
events.quote: Sorin created Avacyn to stand as a guardian of humanity.

events.summary: Sorin forges the Helvault from a piece of Innistrad's silver moon.
events.quote: Sorin also forged the Helvault from a piece of Innistrad's silver moon.

events.summary: Nahiri restores the Eldrazi prison on Zendikar on her own after neither Sorin nor Ugin answers her call.
events.quote: Nahiri restored the prison on her own

events.summary: Nahiri finds Sorin at the Helvault site; he shows no remorse for ignoring her summons and tells her to seek Ugin.
events.quote: Nahiri tracked Sorin down at the Helvault site, still weakened from its creation.

events.summary: Nahiri attacks Sorin and Avacyn intervenes to fight her.
events.quote: Nahiri saw this as a personal betrayal and attacked Sorin.

events.summary: Sorin halts the battle by sealing Nahiri within the Helvault for nearly a millennium.
events.quote: Sorin halted the battle by sealing Nahiri within the Helvault

relations.quote: Sorin created the archangel Avacyn and the Helvault
used the Helvault to imprison Nahiri
